verdicts.evidence: lines 641-668: chips, clear, retry, recheck, prev/next, row actions (paid, remind, undo, delete) and both dialog buttons all have listeners that call the api or change the view and re-render.
lines 526, 453-459, 478-493: rows, chip counts and result count all derive from api.listInvoices(); overdue days computed from due date (331); no hardcoded figures or placeholder text.
lines 592-593: the delete confirmation names the invoice number, customer and amount it acts on, so the decision does not rely on memory of the row.
Only one search input and a status filter, no multi-step task or long free text. (Search, status and page are kept in the URL anyway, lines 305-307, 354-365.)
line 209: filter defaults to All; lines 596-597: dialog opens with focus on 'Keep draft', so Enter keeps the draft; delete needs a deliberate move to 'Delete draft'.
lines 368-374, 663: Mark paid and Send reminder are row buttons that act on one click with no detail page or dialog; search and overdue filter are on the same screen.
lines 199-246: heading, search, status filter with counts, result line, table, pager and delete dialog only. Each maps to find, see overdue, mark paid, remind or delete; no stat cards, feeds or tips.
lines 79-90, 161: all buttons share the outlined style; no filled primary. In the dialog only 'Keep draft' is emphasised (bold, darker border); 'Delete draft' is red text outline.
lines 372, 89, 254-255, 597: 'Delete draft' is an outlined danger-coloured button shown only on draft rows (which have no other action); in the dialog it is not focused and not the emphasised button.

lines 514-518, 599-603: aria-disabled is set only while a request is in flight (Trying again..., Checking..., Deleting...); 'Keep draft' is inert only during the delete with 'Deleting...' beside it. Unavailable row actions are absent (368-374).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
lines 195-256 and all strings in 461-498, 572-624: visible text is headings, labels, statuses and outcome messages; nothing mentions implementation, mock data or the request.
line 593: the only caveat is 'A deleted draft cannot be restored.' inside the delete confirmation, at the decision it informs. No banners or callouts elsewhere.
lines 203, 207: only field and group labels; no text narrates the screen. The one sentence 'They appear here once they are created.' (489) is the empty-state line, not usage instructions.

lines 592-593: dialog title says 'Permanently delete draft NW-x?' and body ends 'A deleted draft cannot be restored.', restating permanence; but the body also adds customer and amount and states the consequence. Verdict differed on second pass.
lines 199, 203, 463, 489-492, 572-624: plain statements naming invoice numbers and actions; no greetings, slogans, superlatives or exclamation marks.

lines 370-372, 221-224, 254-255, 498: 'Mark paid', 'Send reminder', 'Delete draft', 'Keep draft', 'Try again', 'Check again', 'Clear search', 'Show all invoices', 'Undo'. Status chips and Previous/Next page are selectors/navigation, not OK/Submit style labels.

lines 329-338: statuses shown as 'Overdue by N days', 'Sent', 'Paid', 'Draft'; invoice shown by number NW-x, internal inv_ id only in attributes (380); dates and money formatted en-GB (317-323); headers are plain words (231-236).

line 463: 'Invoices could not be loaded. Check your connection, then try again.'; 577-578: 'NW-x was not marked as paid. Try again.'; 614: 'NW-x was not deleted. Try again, or keep the draft.' The raw ECONNRESET error is never shown (catch blocks 528, 574, 612).
lines 463, 577-578, 614: 'could not be loaded', 'was not marked as paid', 'was not sent', 'was not deleted'. No 'failed', 'invalid', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals; subject is the invoice.

lines 489, 495: zero invoices shows 'No invoices yet. They appear here once they are created.' with a 'Check again' button; table hidden (502). No create task exists in the brief, so recheck is the next step.

lines 489 + 495: nothing exists gives 'No invoices yet...' and 'Check again'; 490 + 497-498: no match gives 'No overdue invoices match "x".' and 'Clear search'/'Show all invoices'; 463-465: load failure gives its own message and 'Try again'.

lines 528-530, 463-465: failed load shows message and 'Try again' in the result area, search text kept in state. 574-581: failed mark paid/reminder shows a row message and the action button returns. 612-616: failed delete keeps the dialog open with error.

lines 219, 461-462: 'Loading invoices...' with spinner from first render; 407-409: row shows 'Marking as paid...'/'Sending reminder...' with spinner; 601: 'Deleting...'; 466, 472: 'Trying again...', 'Checking...'. Calls max 1.5 s, none exceed ten seconds.

lines 458, 468-475: while phase is loading the chip counts are blank, the table is hidden and count text is empty; the empty-state line appears only after a response (489), or stays during a recheck that started from a confirmed empty result (473).

line 131: customer wraps with overflow-wrap anywhere; 129: amounts nowrap, tabular, right aligned; 289, 479-482: 25 per page with pager; 340: null reminderSentAt renders as empty text, no 'null'; 155-156: dialog text wraps.
The screen holds no edits saved by an explicit action. Held mark-paid/reminder operations are committed on pagehide and trigger a beforeunload prompt (lines 675-680).
line 204: the only field is a free-text search with no format, length or value constraint.
No form with required and optional fields; the only input is the search box (line 204).
No input validation exists; the search input only filters the list (lines 641, 348-353).
No form that can reject input; the search field accepts any text (line 641).
No form that can be rejected by client or server; server actions are row buttons with no entered values.
No form that can reject input.
No form or submit button on the screen; lines 201-216 hold only a live search field and filter toggles.

No form submits to the server. Row and dialog actions do guard repeats: startOp returns if an op exists (543), confirmDelete returns while busy (606), retry/recheck ignore clicks while loading (650-651).

lines 542-549: clicking Mark paid/Send reminder re-renders at once with 'Marking as paid...' and Undo; 596: delete opens the dialog; 609: confirm shows 'Deleting...'; 644: chip pressed state changes; 466: retry shows 'Trying again...'; 88: :active state.

lines 568-573: on success the row status becomes Paid or shows 'Reminder sent today, hh:mm' (339-344, 404); if the row left the filtered view a notice states it; 618-624: deleted row is removed with 'Draft NW-x deleted.'; failures stated in the row (576-580).

lines 571-573: paid/reminder notices appear only when the row is no longer visible in the current view. Line 624: 'Draft NW-x deleted.' reports a removal that leaves nothing on screen showing which draft went.

lines 427, 544: row errors stay until that row's action is tried again; 463: load error stays until retry succeeds; 614: dialog error stays; 637: notices clear only on a user view change. No timers dismiss messages; only the 6 s undo hold (547) ends by itself.

lines 542-558, 369: Mark paid and Send reminder run with no confirmation dialog and show an Undo button for 6 s (UNDO_MS, 290) before the request is sent; undo cancels the timer and restores the row buttons.

lines 592-597, 254-255: 'Permanently delete draft NW-x?' with customer, amount and 'A deleted draft cannot be restored.'; buttons 'Keep draft' and 'Delete draft'; focus starts on 'Keep draft'. Reminder and mark paid get an undo hold instead (547).
lines 665, 586-598: the only confirmation dialog guards permanent deletion of a draft; mark paid, reminder, filters, clear and paging have none.
lines 559-573: no optimistic update; the row shows a pending note and the status changes only after the server responds with the updated invoice.
lines 249-257, 665: the only modal is the delete confirmation, a single decision with two buttons, opened only by the user clicking 'Delete draft'.

lines 596-597: native dialog via showModal() with focus set on 'Keep draft'; Escape handled through the cancel event (669-671, blocked only while deleting); native close returns focus to the trigger; after delete focus moves to the neighbouring row (625).
lines 199-240: order is heading, search and status filter, one result line, then the invoice table, which takes full width; nothing decorative precedes or outweighs it.
lines 194-216: a small 'Northwind' text line, the h1 'Invoices', then the search and table. No hero, greeting or introductory panel.

lines 209-213, 453-459: the only summary numbers are per-status counts inside the filter chips (for example how many are overdue) and the result count (491-492), each tied to finding and filtering invoices.

lines 485-498: result line reads e.g. '12 overdue invoices matching "acme"' next to a single 'Clear search and filter' / 'Clear search' / 'Show all invoices' button; the active chip is pressed (457) and counts are shown.

All controls are native button, input and dialog elements (lines 204-256, 416-418); focus-visible outline (49); focus is restored when row buttons are swapped (413-425) or a row is removed (433-436, 625).

lines 333, 327: overdue is red plus the word 'Overdue by N days' plus an icon; errors are text messages (142, 427); selected chip is bold with aria-pressed as well as coloured (95), and the result line names the filter (485).

lines 219-225: loading, count and notice are role=status and the failure text role=alert, all present in the initial HTML; row note (role=status) and row error (role=alert) exist from row creation (385); dialog error is role=alert (252).
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs. Filter chips are toggle buttons carrying aria-pressed (lines 209-213, 457); the dialog is a native modal.

lines 164-190: under 900px each row becomes a two-column grid block with number, amount, customer, status, due and wrapping actions; controls grow to 44px; search goes full width; chips wrap (76); dialog is width calc(100% - 32px) (150).
